summary: A 1937 L-4 ground cab in Valley County, Idaho, abandoned around 2000 and registered in 2011; no staffing history is documented.

facts.status_note: Abandoned around 2000 per Idaho Fire Lookouts; still listed as standing by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; current condition not confirmed

access.note: Listed as an abandoned hike-in site; no source says whether the public may visit or climb it

visit.trail_note: Listed as hike-in; the sources give no route details

events.note: L-4 ground cab; firelookout.com says it is the only lookout structure ever on the site
Idaho Fire Lookouts dates abandonment to 2000; firelookout.com says abandoned for several years

evidence.quote: Mahoney Creek Lookout on the Challis National Forest is an L-4 ground house built in 1937.

evidence.supports: built 1937 and only lookout structure ever on the site
evidence.quote: This L-4 cab, built in 1937, is the only lookout structure ever on the site.
It has been abandoned for several years.

evidence.supports: abandoned orphan needing adoption at registration
evidence.quote: It is now an abandoned orphan needing adoption.
We don't yet have a documented staffing history for this lookout.

evidence.supports: listed as an abandoned hike-in site
Forest Fire Lookout Association lists it as standing
evidence.quote: Mahoney Creek Valley 44.76014 -114.95913 Ground Standing NHLR US 935, ID 94

sources.title: Mahoney Creek Fire Lookout Cabin
sources.publisher: firelookout.com (Forest Fire Lookout pages by Rex Kamstra)

sources.title: Mahoney Creek Point Lookout - Idaho Fire Lookouts

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Sources describe abandonment (2000 per Idaho Fire Lookouts; abandoned for several years per firelookout.com; abandoned orphan per the Register), yet the Forest Fire Lookout Association lists it as standing. The record keeps standing with a status note.
The Register's description says Challis National Forest, while its location field and firelookout.com say Boise/Challis National Forests. The story names both.

notes_for_editor: No source after the 2011 registration describes the current condition or any visit. No staffing history found. The 2000 abandonment date rests on one site. No photos added.
